message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 26 November 2026, 23:40 UTC to 27 November 2026, 23:40 UTC (28 November, 05:10 IST). **Scope:** Products.txt only, normalized and deduplicated, plus the required MongoDB ecosystem sweep.

No newly disclosed vulnerability was confirmed in the available results as both relevant to the listed products and within the exact 24-hour window. One potentially relevant vLLM security change needs review.

**Possible match needing review: vLLM Rust frontend, DeepSeek V4.1**

**Severity:** Not stated; no CVE identified in the maintainer change. On 27 November, maintainers merged a change that treats special-token spellings in client-supplied text as ordinary text in the DeepSeek V4.1 Rust renderer. A security briefing describes the prior behavior as allowing forged conversation turns. vLLM is monitored, but the affected released versions, exposure conditions and release containing the change were not established; a merge to the main branch alone does not establish a released fix. Review deployments using this particular frontend and model. [Maintainer change](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/70271), [security briefing](https://mindpattern.ai/briefings/2026-11-27).

**MongoDB ecosystem sweep:** Searches included MongoDB security alerts, CVE records, GitHub advisories and CISA-oriented sources, covering Server and mongod/mongos, Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, database tools, Kubernetes operators, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services and official integrations, including advisories identified by component or CVE rather than MongoDB in the title. No new in-window issue was verified from the available results. In particular, CVE-2026-135898, CVE-2026-135227 and CVE-2026-135147 were reported on 25 November despite appearing in a 27 November digest; they are not new disclosures in this window. [MongoDB alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), [Python driver CVE record](https://db.gcve.eu/vuln/cve-2026-135898).

**Closing:** Review the vLLM change where that frontend is deployed. Search indexing and sources that provide dates without times limit completeness; absence of a confirmed finding is not proof of absence.
